_metadata.description: Phase 4 shadow literature resolution registry for high-impact canonical actives

literature_evidence_records.material_form: generic carotenoid / tomato extract or synthetic lycopene
literature_evidence_records.search_query: ("Lycopene"[tiab] OR "lycopene extract"[tiab]) AND (meta-analysis[pt] OR systematic review[pt] OR practice guideline[pt] OR "randomized controlled trial"[pt]) NOT (animals[mh] NOT humans[mh])

qualifying_human_studies.title: Lycopene for the prevention of prostate cancer
qualifying_human_studies.primary_endpoint: prostate cancer incidence

qualifying_human_studies.title: Effects of lycopene on biomarkers of oxidative stress and inflammation

literature_evidence_records.population_context: Adults; cardiovascular biomarkers vs prostate cancer prevention

literature_evidence_records.search_query: ("Zeaxanthin"[tiab] OR "meso-zeaxanthin"[tiab]) AND (randomized controlled trial[pt] OR systematic review[pt]) NOT (animals[mh] NOT humans[mh])

literature_evidence_records.search_query: ("L-Tyrosine"[tiab] OR "tyrosine"[tiab]) AND (cognition[tiab] OR stress[tiab]) AND (randomized controlled trial[pt] OR crossover[tiab]) NOT (animals[mh] NOT humans[mh])

literature_evidence_records.material_form: Capsicum annuum fruit / capsaicinoids (standardized extract or powder)

literature_evidence_records.material_form: Punica granatum fruit extract / standardized punicalagins
